short_bio: Attorney and politician; former California attorney general, senator and vice president.
biography:
Kamala Harris was born in Oakland, California, earned her undergraduate degree at Howard University and her law degree at UC Hastings. Alameda County employed her as a deputy district attorney before San Francisco voters made her District Attorney in 2004.

She was California’s Attorney General from 2011 to 2017 and a US Senator from 2017 to 2021. In 2021 she became Vice President, the first woman to hold the office, and in 2024 she was the Democratic nominee for president.

She lost that election to Donald Trump.
